name: My App Name
tagline: One short line describing the app (shown under the name, ~60-80 chars)
description: First paragraph — what the app is and the problem it solves. Two or three sentences.
Second paragraph — how it works, what makes it different, anything notable about the experience. Add more paragraphs as extra array items if needed.
features: Feature four (4-8 items look best in the two-column grid)

dataCollected.type: EXAMPLE — Email address (delete this array's items if collectsPersonalData is false)
dataCollected.purpose: Why it is collected and where it is stored, e.g. 'Used for account sign-in. Stored securely in Firebase.'

permissions.name: Camera
permissions.reason: Why the app needs it, e.g. 'Used to scan documents. Images never leave your device.'

permissions.name: Notifications
permissions.reason: Used to deliver reminder alerts you schedule.

privacy.dataDeletionNote: How users can delete their data, e.g. 'All data lives only on your device. Uninstalling the app or clearing its storage removes everything.'
